counterfactual_missing_items: No physical examination findings were explicitly mentioned in the case report
decisive_items: Germline mutation R1331X was detected in the MSH6 gene
Family history was significant for prostate cancer in her father and paternal grandfather
Tumor stained negative for MSH6 protein
response.rationale: Only R1 was supplied. The pathogenic germline MSH6 mutation and cancer family history are directly diagnostic of Lynch syndrome; MSH6 IHC loss is concordant, and negative MSI does not override the germline finding.
